provider: Solana account rent as raw storage

free_tier.stated: No free tier. Storage is a refundable rent-exempt deposit: 10 MiB account costs 53,268,311,040 lamports (~53.27 SOL) to create, reclaimed only on close.
free_tier.notes: Headline offer; binding constraint specified in limits.

per_object_cap.stated: No per-object cap documented in published terms; absence is not an unlimited claim.
per_object_cap.notes: extraction found no per-object clause; some of these providers meter on object count rather than bytes, and some state no cap

retention.stated: No retention statement documented in published terms; absence is not an unlimited claim.
retention.notes: extraction found no retention clause; the seed's limits text may still state one, see extras.limits_verbatim

egress.terms: Free reads via RPC while the account exists; all RPC providers rate-limit or block bulk account-data reads.

tooling: Solana JSON-RPC (getMinimumBalanceForRentExemption, getAccountInfo), solana-sdk, Anchor. Wrapper examples exist but nothing production-grade for bulk file storage.
chaining: Cost scales linearly with bytes at ~5 SOL/MiB; 1 TiB would need ~5.3 million SOL of locked capital. Sharding across wallets does not reduce the deposit.
limits_note: Rent-exempt deposit per byte; per-transaction size cap means large accounts are written in many transactions; account data is public and account creation is rate-limited/expensive.

identity_cost.detail: no identity_cost field and no identity statement in the source record; defaulted to email and flagged, not evidence

reliability_note: Funds are recoverable on close (so it is a deposit, not a fee) but the capital lock at TB scale is prohibitive; the public RPC blocked this session's probes (403 'Your IP or provider is blocked').
confidence_note: mechanically converted from the seed corpus; no page was read for this record in the storage-dossier pass. One page read moves it to documented.
